title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: loading more by scrolling keeps groups open or closed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • More than 30 vendors have overdue bills on today's date; {Vendor-A} is among the first 30 in name order.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-14 First Page.
  • Starting screen: A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report") is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with only {Vendor-A}'s group expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Scroll down until the next 30 vendors load.
  2. Scroll back up to the top of the table.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the next groups load as you scroll; there are no page buttons.
  • Step 2: {Vendor-A}'s group is still expanded and the other groups among the first 30 are still collapsed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R8: “Re-sorting and paging keep every group's expanded or collapsed state.”
  • S1-R8: “A/R Summary, A/P Summary, A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices show 30 customers or vendors at a time, and the next 30 load as the user scrolls down, as today. There are no page buttons. A/R Detail and A/P Detail show each bucket's first 100 lines, then load more as the user scrolls (S4-R4). Paging never repeats or skips a customer, vendor or row, in any sort.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html); page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p3-expand-all-from-the-header.png: figure "Expand all from the header" (This build (after)), board "3. Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows"
  • ar-ap-p1-a-r-aging-summary-opens-a-to-z.png: figure "A/R Aging Summary opens A to Z" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"

The design's own words:

  • "One chevron in the top-left header cell: "Collapse all" while any group is open, "Expand all" when none is. Group toggles use the same chevron. S4-R1 to S4-R5, S4-R8." (caption of "Expand all from the header")
  • "Customer name order the way QuickBooks sorts ("10 Trucking" before "2 Trucking"), marked on the Customer header. S1-R1, S1-R2, S1-R4, S1-R7, S1-R8." (caption of "A/R Aging Summary opens A to Z")
